# Gobstopper

> Gobstopper inspects Claude Code, Codex, and Devin sessions and prepares compacted transcript copies. The source build prepares separate Codex and Claude Code copies and disables direct provider-store edits and automatic provider compaction.

When to use this site:
- Use gobstopper.sh to learn what Gobstopper does, which strategies it runs, and how to install it.
- Use /docs for the full reference: installation, strategies, configuration, the watcher, hooks, the snapshot vault, and the MCP server.
- Use /methodology for the occupancy model behind the projections and what each strategy does.
- Use /benchmarks for dated results, cohort sizes, limitations, and aggregate downloads.
- Use /blog for longer posts on what Gobstopper does and how its archive and edit limits are checked.

## Pages

- [Gobstopper](https://gobstopper.sh/): what Gobstopper does, how to install it, and what it will not do to a running session.
- [Gobstopper documentation](https://gobstopper.sh/docs): the README, with every command, strategy, and configuration setting it documents.
- [Gobstopper methodology](https://gobstopper.sh/methodology): the occupancy model, the strategies, and the limits of the published benchmarks.
- [Gobstopper benchmarks](https://gobstopper.sh/benchmarks): offline replays of 729 archived sessions, a synthetic snapshot-recovery study, and historical single-session resume trials.

## Blog

- [Gobstopper blog](https://gobstopper.sh/blog): every post, newest first. Atom feed at https://gobstopper.sh/blog/feed.xml.
- [Introducing Gobstopper](https://gobstopper.sh/blog/introducing-gobstopper): what Gobstopper does, who it is for, and how to try it.
- [How Gobstopper proves its compaction arithmetic and transcript laws](https://gobstopper.sh/blog/proofs-for-the-admission-math): what the Kani and Lean proofs cover and leave out.
- [How Gobstopper checks its archive design against crashes at every step](https://gobstopper.sh/blog/vault-models-that-fail-on-purpose): the TLA+ models, their broken copies, and the Hegel tests.
